productionRule: Only exact, source-backed, vehicle/ECU-specific operations may be placed in 'operations'. Research candidates are intentionally non-executable and are ignored by the current app loader.
whyOperationsAreStillEmpty: The current manufacturer catalog authorizes no VerifiedService vehicle definitions.
The current OEM definition catalog contains no service-write ECU definition for the requested brands.
The operation loader requires an exact reviewed ECU definition and VerifiedService authorization.
A service operation must include an exact 0x2E/0x31 execute request and an exact read-only 0x22 VERIFY step.
Filling these bytes by inference would create unsafe false positives on real vehicles.
promotionChecklist: Exact ECU definition and address verified
Exact request bytes captured or documented
Manufacturer catalog upgraded to VerifiedService for that definition

protocolEvidence: BMW EDIABAS SGBD references document CBS_RESET using UDS/KWP WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E).
BMW EDIABAS SGBD references document CBS reset-related read data and CBS save routine F0ED.
familyResearchCandidates.blockReason: CBS reset payload is generated from the specific CBS item/availability/service counter/date fields and varies by ECU/CBS generation; no single universal payload is safe.

protocolEvidence: BMW EDIABAS references document KWP2000 routine 31 30 00 10 00 for battery replacement registration on applicable ECU generations.
familyResearchCandidates.blockReason: The current GCar360 operation path is exact-profile UDS/ISO-TP oriented; this KWP operation cannot be promoted without exact supported vehicle/ECU mappings and transport validation.

protocolEvidence: Mercedes service literature documents ASSYST/ASSYST PLUS service scope, remaining distance/time and reset behavior.
familyResearchCandidates.blockReason: No source-backed universal raw UDS/KWP request, exact cluster/CGW address, and post-reset DID set is available for all Mercedes platforms.
sourceReferences: Mercedes-Benz service literature: ASSYST / ASSYST PLUS reset procedures

protocolEvidence: Ross-Tech documents UDS instrument-cluster adaptation item 'ESI: Resetting ESI'.
